description: Check a single code snippet against enforceable YAML rules under rules/ and return line-level issues (rule id, message, suggestion). Markdown skills are advisory via list_skills/get_context — they are not machine-validated here. For folders or multiple files, use the multi-file evaluation tool instead.

filePath.description: Virtual or real path for glob/exception/language detection

language.description: Any language id/alias: typescript, python, java, go, rust, csharp, … Detected from filePath if omitted.

runExternal.description: Also run optional external checkers (tsc/complexity/secrets) with timeouts

name: validate_code
title: Validate code
